classes.summary: DevicesMFE is a page class that extends HPXFlow and provides verification and action flows for the Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) in the HP application. It handles device management operations including verifying UI elements, interacting with device cards, managing printer devices, and navigating through the devices interface.
